overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: budget-related topics discussed under a posted quarterly budget update naturally flowed from that topic, and no executive session was required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee discussed a facilities maintenance agreement and municipal employees at its Oct. 21, 2024 meeting, topics not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Where a public body’s discussion naturally flows from its consideration of the posted agenda topic, the notice was sufficient to inform the public of the discussion that occurred.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee was required to meet in executive session because it discussed a complaint against a town employee.
allegations.key_passage: Even if this brief discussion related to a complaint against the Assistant Town Administrator, which we do not believe it did, the Committee was not required to have such discussion in executive session and the subject of the discussion has no right under the Open Meeting Law to demand that the Committee do so.
